label: Access this line item
summary: A game function of the GUI that gives access to the line item itself; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name and the other 'AccessSelf' functions, it hands the object itself to the interface code. No game file uses it with this type, and the game lists no return type.

label: Line item's item
summary: The item that one entry of the domicile line tree stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of an element in the domicile window, so the element's parts can read that item. The game lists no return type.

label: This line item
summary: The line item itself, so it can be passed on to another function.
details: Going by its name and how other 'Self' functions are used (for example Character.Self passed as an argument), it hands the object on. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Set up bottom widget
summary: Going by its name, prepares the bottom widget of a line item, and answers yes or no.
details: Vanilla puts it in a visible condition and passes the widget itself (PdxGuiWidget.Self), so it seems to set the widget up as a side effect while deciding whether to show it. Used in the domicile window.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a GUI widget, in vanilla PdxGuiWidget.Self

label: Set up top widget
summary: Going by its name, prepares the top widget of a line item, and answers yes or no.
details: Vanilla puts it in a visible condition and passes the widget itself (PdxGuiWidget.Self), so it seems to set the widget up as a side effect while deciding whether to show it. Used in the domicile window.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a GUI widget, in vanilla PdxGuiWidget.Self

label: Access tree items
summary: A game function of the GUI that gives access to the items of the domicile line tree; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name, it gives the interface access to the tree's items. Same-name uses in vanilla belong to other types (a list of obligation levels, a list of religions) and are only a hint.

label: Access this line tree
summary: A game function of the GUI that gives access to the line tree itself; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name and the other 'AccessSelf' functions, it hands the object itself to the interface code. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Tree connections
summary: The list of connections between the nodes of the domicile line tree.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list a part of the domicile window repeats over (datamodel), probably to draw the lines between buildings. The game lists no return type.

label: Tree item position
summary: The on-screen position of a given node of the domicile line tree, as a pair of numbers.
details: Vanilla uses it for the position of a widget and passes the node itself (DomicileTreeNode.Self), so each node is placed where the tree says.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The tree node to find the position of.
fields.values: a domicile tree node, in vanilla DomicileTreeNode.Self

label: Tree items
summary: The list of items in the domicile line tree.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list a part of the domicile window repeats over (datamodel), once per tree item. The game lists no return type.

label: Tree root building
summary: Going by its name, the building at the root (start) of the domicile line tree; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it and the game lists no return type.

label: This line tree
summary: The line tree itself, so it can be passed on to another function.
details: Going by its name and how other 'Self' functions are used (for example Character.Self passed as an argument), it hands the object on. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Set up lines container
summary: Going by its name, prepares the widget that holds the tree's lines, and answers yes or no.
details: Vanilla puts it in a visible condition and passes the widget itself (PdxGuiWidget.Self), so it seems to set the widget up as a side effect while deciding whether to show it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The widget that holds the lines.
fields.values: a GUI widget, in vanilla PdxGuiWidget.Self

label: Access this overview item
summary: A game function of the GUI that gives access to the overview building item itself; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name and the other 'AccessSelf' functions, it hands the object itself to the interface code. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Can upgrade
summary: Whether this building in the domicile overview can be upgraded.
details: Vanilla uses it in visible conditions of the domicile window, alone, negated, and together with the edit mode check, to show or hide upgrade parts.

label: Overview building
summary: The domicile building this overview entry stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of an element in the domicile window, so the element's parts can show that building. The game lists no return type.

label: Internal buildings
summary: The list of internal buildings that belong to this overview building.
details: Vanilla only checks whether this list is empty (IsDataModelEmpty), to show or hide a fold-out part of the domicile window. The game lists no return type.

label: Building tier
summary: The tier of this overview building, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it directly as text in the domicile window.

label: This overview item
summary: The overview building item itself, so it can be passed on to another function.
details: Going by its name and how other 'Self' functions are used (for example Character.Self passed as an argument), it hands the object on. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Access these settings
summary: A game function of the GUI that gives access to the domicile settings object itself; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name and the other 'AccessSelf' functions, it hands the object itself to the interface code. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Background texture
summary: The background picture of the domicile window.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the domicile window. The game lists no return type.

label: Foreground texture
summary: The foreground picture of the domicile window, drawn in front of the background.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the domicile window, next to the background texture function. The game lists no return type.

label: Domicile type
summary: The domicile type the window currently shows.
details: Vanilla chains it to get the type's name or its title text for a character (GetName, GetTitleText( Character.Self )) in the domicile window. The game lists no return type.

label: These settings
summary: The domicile settings object itself, so it can be passed on to another function.
details: Going by its name and how other 'Self' functions are used (for example Character.Self passed as an argument), it hands the object on. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Toggle type
summary: Going by its name, toggles the domicile type of the window; the game documents nothing more.
details: Vanilla runs it from a click (onclick) in the domicile window. It returns nothing.

label: Access this tree node
summary: A game function of the GUI that gives access to the tree node itself; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name and the other 'AccessSelf' functions, it hands the object itself to the interface code. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Node building
summary: The domicile building this tree node stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of an element in the domicile window, so the element's parts can show that building. The game lists no return type.

label: Node tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of this tree node.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of tree nodes in the domicile window. It returns text.

label: Node tier
summary: The tier of this tree node, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it directly as text in the domicile window. Unlike the overview building's tier, this one returns text, not a number.

label: Node is selected
summary: Whether this tree node is the one currently selected.
details: Vanilla combines it with a check whether the node's building is internal, to show different parts for internal and other buildings.

label: Node is unavailable
summary: Whether this tree node is unavailable.
details: Vanilla uses it together with the unlocked check, for nodes that are not unlocked, to show different parts for unavailable and available ones. What makes a node unavailable is not given.

label: Node is unlocked
summary: Whether this tree node is unlocked.
details: Vanilla uses it alone and negated, often with the unavailable check, to give locked nodes a different look.

label: Click node
summary: Does what a click on this tree node should do.
details: Vanilla runs it from a click (onclick) on tree nodes in the domicile window. It returns nothing. What exactly it does is not documented.

label: This tree node
summary: The tree node itself, so it can be passed on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to DomicileLineTree.GetItemPosition to find where the node sits.

label: Access this domicile type
summary: A game function of the GUI that gives access to the domicile type itself; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name and the other 'AccessSelf' functions, it hands the object itself to the interface code. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Can travel
summary: Going by its name, whether this kind of domicile can travel; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. It returns yes or no.

label: Type icon
summary: Going by its name, the icon of this domicile type; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it with this type. Same-name uses in vanilla (a DLC icon, an inspiration type icon) are texture lines for other types and only a hint. The game lists no return type.

label: Type illustration
summary: The large illustration picture of this domicile type.
details: Vanilla uses the same function on a character's domicile type (Domicile.GetType.GetIllustration) as a texture in the outliner. Going by that and its name, it gives the type's picture. The game lists no return type.

label: Map pin texture
summary: The picture used for this domicile type's pin on the map.
details: Going by the same function name on a domicile's type (Domicile.GetType.GetMapPinTexture), used as a texture in the map icon layer, it gives the pin picture. No game file names it with this type. The game lists no return type.

label: Move cost
summary: What it costs the given character to move a domicile of this type.
details: It takes one argument, the character. Vanilla hands the result to the global GetCostString to show it under "Cost:" in the move descriptions of the estate and the Japanese manor. The game lists no return type.

fields.name: character
fields.text: The character who would move the domicile.

label: Move tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tooltip text about moving this kind of domicile, for a given character.
details: The same function name is used on a domicile's type with the character (Domicile.GetType.GetMoveTooltip( Character.Self )) as a tooltip in the map icon layer and the county view. No game file names it with this type. It returns text.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the tooltip is about.

label: Domicile type name
summary: The name of the domicile type (for example an estate), as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in trigger texts such as "... is a ..." and "... is not a ...", which check a domicile's type.

label: Type name, plain
summary: Going by its name, the name of this domicile type as plain text, without the hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in the outliner text for the domicile.

label: Type name, possessive
summary: The possessive form of the domicile type's name, as plain text without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla puts it after a character's house name to name that house's domicile, in a text of the ep3 expansion.

label: High temperament text
summary: Going by its name, the description text for a high temperament value of this domicile type; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. It takes one argument and returns text.

label: Low temperament text
summary: Going by its name, the description text for a low temperament value of this domicile type; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. It takes one argument and returns text.

label: Neutral temperament text
summary: Going by its name, the description text for a neutral temperament of this domicile type; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. It returns text.

label: Title text
summary: Going by its name, a title text for this domicile type, for a given character.
details: It takes one argument and returns text. Vanilla uses it on a domicile's type with a character (DomicileSettings.GetType.GetTitleText( Character.Self )) in the domicile window, which fits.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the text is for.

label: Has lobby map pin
summary: Whether this domicile type shows a lobby pin on the map.
details: Vanilla uses it on a domicile's type in the map icon layer, together with checks that the character is a landless ruler with a government. 'Lobby' is the game's own word here and is not explained.

label: Has map pin anchor
summary: Whether this domicile type's map pin is anchored on a given side.
details: The same function name is used on a domicile's type with a direction word such as 'up' or 'left', in conditions that show the pin in different places, also depending on whether the province has a coat of arms. No game file names it with this type.

label: Is domicile type
summary: Going by its name, whether this domicile type is the given type; the game documents nothing more.
details: It takes one argument and returns yes or no. No game file uses it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; probably the type to compare with.

label: This domicile type
summary: The domicile type itself, so it can be passed on to another function.
details: Going by its name and how other 'Self' functions are used (for example Character.Self passed as an argument), it hands the object on. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Uses culture and faith
summary: Whether this domicile type uses a culture and a faith.
details: The same function name is used on a domicile's type (Domicile.GetType.UsesCultureAndFaith) to show or hide parts of the domicile window, three times. No game file names it with this type.

label: Uses provisions
summary: Going by its name, whether this domicile type uses provisions; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. It returns yes or no.

label: Access this window
summary: A game function of the GUI that gives access to the domicile window itself; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name and the other 'AccessSelf' functions, it hands the object itself to the interface code. No game file uses it with this type.

label: Cache relation type
summary: Going by its name, makes the domicile window look up and remember the characters with a given relation.
details: Vanilla calls it when the window starts, three times, with the relations elder, disciple and fellow disciple. GetRelationOfType, which takes the same kind of relation, probably reads the result. It returns nothing.

label: Can move manually
summary: Going by its name, whether the domicile can be moved by hand.
details: Vanilla uses it, with the edit mode check and a check that the interface is not hidden (variable 'hide_ui'), as a visible condition in the domicile window.

label: Can put in selected slot
summary: Going by its name, whether a given artifact can be put in the selected artifact slot; the game documents nothing more.
details: It takes one argument and returns yes or no. No game file uses it.

label: Put in slot tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tooltip text that explains whether a given artifact can go in the selected slot; the game documents nothing more.
details: It takes one argument and returns text. No game file uses it.

label: Can slot hold artifact
summary: Going by its name, whether a given slot can hold the selected artifact.
details: No game file uses it with this type. Vanilla uses the same function name on the royal court window with an inventory slot (RoyalCourtWindow.CanSlotHoldSelectedArtifact( InventorySlot.Self )), a hint at most.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The slot to check; in the royal court use, an inventory slot.
fields.values: an inventory slot, in vanilla InventorySlot.Self

label: Clear construction notice
summary: Clears the 'construction started' notice in the domicile window.
details: Vanilla runs it when the window opens and on a click. It returns nothing. The name says what is cleared; the exact effect is not documented.

label: Clear internal selection
summary: Clears the selection of an internal building in the domicile window.
details: Vanilla runs it on clicks in the domicile window, three times. It returns nothing.

label: Clear new building effect
summary: Clears the 'new building' highlight for one building slot.
details: Vanilla runs it on clicks and passes the slot (DomicileBuildingSlot.Self), so the highlight goes away once the player has seen it. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The building slot to clear the effect for.
fields.values: a domicile building slot, in vanilla DomicileBuildingSlot.Self

label: Clear selected artifact
summary: Going by its name, clears the selected artifact.
details: No game file uses it with this type. Vanilla uses the same function name on the royal court window, at window start and on clicks, a hint at most. It returns nothing.

label: Clear selected artifact slot
summary: Going by its name, clears the selected artifact slot; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. It returns nothing.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the domicile window.
details: Vanilla runs it from clicks on close buttons. The same name is used for many other windows. It returns nothing.

label: Equip artifact
summary: Going by its name, equips an artifact; the game documents nothing more.
details: It takes one argument and returns nothing. No game file uses it.

label: Free slot index
summary: Going by its name, the number of a free slot; the game documents nothing more.
details: It takes one argument and returns a whole number. No game file uses it.

label: Artifact claims list
summary: Going by its name, the list of artifact claims; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it with this type. Vanilla uses the same function name on the inventory view as a data context, a hint at most. The game lists no return type.

label: Artifact sort options
summary: Going by its name, the list of ways to sort artifacts; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it with this type. The inventory view and royal court window use the same function name as the list of a drop-down, a hint at most. The game lists no return type.

label: Selected sort option
summary: Going by its name, the position of the chosen artifact sort option, as a pair of numbers.
details: No game file uses it with this type. The inventory view and royal court window use the same function name as the selected index of a drop-down, a hint at most.

label: Building slots
summary: The list of building slots of the domicile.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list parts of the domicile window repeat over (datamodel), once per slot. The game lists no return type.

label: Cancel construction tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the button that cancels a construction.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window. It returns text.

label: Window's character
summary: Going by its name, the character the domicile window is about.
details: Vanilla uses it in game texts and chains further calls to it, for example the character's house and the character's name forms. The game lists no return type.

label: Building in selected slot
summary: The building that is built in the selected slot.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the domicile window. The game lists no return type.

label: Culture sets
summary: The list of culture sets the domicile window offers.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list a selection part of the domicile window repeats over (datamodel). What a culture set is is not explained. The game lists no return type.

label: Window's domicile
summary: The domicile the window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of many parts of the domicile window, so they can read the domicile's data. The game lists no return type.

label: Domicile line tree
summary: The line tree (the tree of buildings and their connections) shown in the window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the tree part of the domicile window. The game lists no return type.

label: Domicile settings
summary: The settings object of the domicile window (its type and pictures).
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the window; the parts then read the type and the background and foreground textures from it. It returns a DomicileSettings.

label: Filtered artifacts
summary: Going by its name, the list of artifacts left after filtering; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. The game lists no return type.

label: Follower card items
summary: The list of follower cards shown in the domicile window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list a part of the window repeats over (datamodel). What the cards contain is not documented. The game lists no return type.

label: Go to location tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the button that goes to the domicile's location.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window. It returns text.

label: Hovered culture set
summary: The position of the culture set the mouse is over, as a pair of numbers.
details: Vanilla uses it as the selected index of the culture set list in the domicile window.

label: Next upgrade
summary: The next upgrade the domicile can get.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of parts of the domicile window. The game lists no return type.

label: Next upgrade cost
summary: The cost breakdown of the next upgrade.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the domicile window, which shows the cost items. The game lists no return type.

label: Overview buildings
summary: The list of buildings shown in the domicile overview.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list a part of the domicile window repeats over (datamodel). The game lists no return type.

label: Potential buildings
summary: The list of buildings that could be built in the domicile.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list a part of the domicile window repeats over (datamodel). The game lists no return type.

label: Preview cost
summary: The cost breakdown of the building being previewed.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the domicile window, which shows the cost items. The game lists no return type.

label: Characters with relation
summary: The characters with a given relation (elder, disciple or fellow disciple in vanilla), as a list.
details: Vanilla passes those three relations and uses the list in the domicile window; it also checks whether the list is empty. The game lists no return type. Whose relations are listed is not documented.

label: Selected artifact
summary: Going by its name, the artifact currently selected.
details: No game file uses it with this type. The royal court window and the interaction window use the same function name for the selected artifact, a hint at most. The game lists no return type.

label: Selected artifact slot
summary: Going by its name, the artifact slot currently selected; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. The game lists no return type.

label: Selected building slot
summary: The building slot currently selected in the window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of parts of the domicile window. The game lists no return type.

label: Selected internal slot number
summary: Going by its name, the number of the selected internal building slot, as a whole number.
details: No game file uses it.

label: Selected slot number
summary: The number of the selected building slot, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla passes it to SetShowConstructionStartedNotification when clicking.

label: Selected tree preview
summary: The building of the tree that is selected for preview.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of parts of the window and passes it to the domicile's HasBuildingOrHigherTier check, so the window knows whether the previewed building is already built. The game lists no return type.

label: Sorted artifacts
summary: Going by its name, the list of artifacts in sorted order.
details: No game file uses it with this type. The inventory view uses the same function name as a list and to test whether it is empty, a hint at most. The game lists no return type.

label: Sorted artifacts for slot
summary: Going by its name, the sorted artifacts that fit the selected slot; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. The game lists no return type.

label: Temperament frame
summary: Going by its name, the frame number of the temperament image, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it as the frame of an image in the domicile window.

label: Temperament modifier text
summary: The tooltip text describing the effects of the temperament.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window. It returns text.

label: Temperament text
summary: The text that names or describes the temperament shown in the window.
details: Vanilla uses it directly as text in the domicile window. It returns text.

label: Under construction header
summary: Going by its name, the heading text for what is under construction; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. It returns text.

label: Has filtered artifacts
summary: Going by its name, whether any artifacts are left after filtering; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. It returns yes or no.

label: Has rename window
summary: Going by its name, whether the domicile window has a rename window.

label: Has selected artifact
summary: Going by its name, whether an artifact is selected.
details: No game file uses it with this type. The royal court and interaction windows use the same function name as a yes or no check, a hint at most.

label: Has selected artifact slot
summary: Going by its name, whether an artifact slot is selected; the game documents nothing more.
details: No game file uses it. It returns yes or no.

label: Inspect tree building
summary: Going by its name, puts a building of the line tree up for inspection.
details: Vanilla runs it on a click and passes the building (DomicileBuilding.Self). IsInspectLineTreeBuilding is probably its counterpart. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a domicile building, in vanilla DomicileBuilding.Self

label: Artifact is selected
summary: Going by its name, whether a given artifact is the selected one.

label: Sort order is descending

label: Select tree upgrade
summary: Going by its name, selects an upgrade in the tree; the game documents nothing more.
details: It takes one argument and returns nothing. No game file uses it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; probably the upgrade or tree node.

label: Slot has type
summary: Going by its name, whether the selected artifact slot has a given type; the game documents nothing more.
details: It takes one argument and returns yes or no. No game file uses it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; probably a slot type.

label: This window
summary: The domicile window itself, so it can be passed on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the Domicile.BuildBuilding command, together with the building, both to start a construction and to check that it is allowed.

label: Select artifact
summary: Going by its name, sets the selected artifact.
details: No game file uses it with this type. The interaction confirmation window uses the same function name on a click with an artifact (Artifact.Self), a hint at most. It returns nothing.

label: Set construction notice
summary: Sets whether the 'construction started' notice is shown for a slot.
details: Vanilla runs it on clicks and passes the selected slot's number (GetSelectedSlotIndex). ShowConstructionStartedNotification probably reads the state back. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number, in vanilla DomicileWindow.GetSelectedSlotIndex

label: Slot should be enabled
summary: Going by its name, whether a given artifact slot should be enabled; the game documents nothing more.
details: It takes one argument and returns yes or no. No game file uses it.

label: Show construction notice
summary: Whether the 'construction started' notice should be shown for a given building slot.
details: Vanilla passes the slot (DomicileBuildingSlot.Self) and combines it with the check that the slot is under construction, to show one of two parts.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a domicile building slot, in vanilla DomicileBuildingSlot.Self

label: Show new building effect
summary: Whether the 'new building' highlight should be shown for a given building slot.
details: Vanilla passes the slot (DomicileBuildingSlot.Self) and uses the answer, alone and negated, to show or hide the highlight on slots that are built and not free.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a domicile building slot, in vanilla DomicileBuildingSlot.Self
